test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 07 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Under which Article of the Constitution does a citizen have the freedom to practice any profession or occupation?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 19 (1) (g).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 19 (1) (g)** of the Indian Constitution guarantees the right to practice any** profession, occupation, trade or business.**
 
• This right can be **restricted by the State** for reasons such as **public interest, morality, and health.**
 
• The freedom to practice any profession or occupation is an essential aspect of the **right to livelihood, **which is a fundamental right under Article 21 of the Constitution.
 
• This right is crucial for individuals to pursue their chosen **career paths** and contribute to the** economic growth** of the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 22 (b)** guarantees** protection against arrest and detention **in certain cases.
 
• **Article 21 (A) **guarantees the **right to education.**
 
• **Article 20 (c)** guarantees protection against **self-incrimination.**
